description: The full verdict for one task: the cheapest model that clears the bar, its pass rate and cost per successful task in US dollars, the baseline model it is compared with, every candidate's status, plus links to the verdict page, the run file (JSON) and the script that re-runs it. Get the slug from list_verdicts.

dataset.description: Public dataset behind the run: name, rows, source, licence.

pass_bar.description: Pass-rate threshold the cheapest model has to clear (0 to 1).
